title: INDIA bloc plans 'Akrosh March' across Bihar against the CEC
seoTitle: Patna INDIA bloc 'Akrosh March' against CEC

tea.why: Opposition parties allege irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls and accuse the CEC of acting for the BJP.
tea.want: Removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and action on alleged voter roll irregularities.
tea.changed: Oct 5: Tejashwi Yadav announced block-level marches on Oct 7 and a march in Patna with district protests on Oct 8.

summary: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav announced on October 5 that the INDIA bloc in Bihar will hold an 'Akrosh March' at block level across the state on October 7 against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. On October 8 the alliance plans district-level demonstrations and a march in Patna to submit a memorandum to the Governor. Yadav accused the CEC of acting at the behest of the BJP-led government.
demands: Action on alleged irregularities in the SIR
response: No response from the Election Commission is reported in these sources.

updates.text: Tejashwi Yadav announced block-level 'Akrosh Marches' for Oct 7 and a Patna march on Oct 8.
